This upgrade is driven by that date, not by a feature need. It also closes a security item for free: eslint 9 pulls minimatch 3.1.5 (directly, plus via @eslint/config-array@0.21.2 and @eslint/eslintrc@3.3.5), which pulls brace-expansion 1.1.16, which is covered by GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (CVSS 7.5, affected <= 5.0.7, patched only in 5.0.8 -- so the v1 branch has NO in-range fix). ESLint v10.0.0 lists `501abd0 feat!: update dependency minimatch to v10 (#20246)` as a breaking change, so v10 removes that branch entirely. This was split out of `deps-security-bump` on 2026-07-29 because a major toolchain upgrade does not belong in a dependency-floor slice. RESOLVED in the first registration: eslint@10.7.0 chosen and installed, verified against minimumReleaseAge, all compat questions measured favorably. See _reregistration_note for what changed between registrations.
_why_not_the_other_route: Forcing `brace-expansion@1` to ^5 via an override is NOT an option and must not be attempted: v1 is `module.exports = expandTop` (a function) while v5 CJS is `exports.expand` (an object), and the sole consumer minimatch@3.1.5 calls `require('brace-expansion')(...)` as a function. pnpm resolves it cleanly, nothing fails at install, and lint dies at call time with `expand is not a function`. Measured 2026-07-29.
